title: Rotation Trajectory
text: Generate trajectory between two orientations, 6 inputs, 3 outputs, {Final rotation} sets Final orientation [0 0 1; {Rotation format} sets the format for orientations, {Waypoint source} sets the source for waypoints, {Initial rotation} sets the initial orientation, {Time interval} sets the start and end times for trajectory, {Use custom time scaling} enables custom time scaling, {Parameter source} sets the source for waypoints, {Time scaling time}, {Time scaling values} sets the time scaling vector and first two derivatives and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Time
ports.summary: Time point along trajectory scalar | vector

ports.name: R0
ports.summary: Initial orientation four-element quaternion vector | 3-by-3 rotation matrix

ports.name: RF
ports.summary: Final orientation four-element vector | 3-by-3 rotation matrix

ports.name: TimeInterval
ports.summary: Start and end times for trajectory two-element vector

ports.name: TSTime
ports.summary: Time scaling time points scalar | p -element vector

ports.name: TimeScaling
ports.summary: Time scaling vector and first two derivatives three-element vector | 3-by- p matrix

ports.name: R
ports.summary: Orientation vectors 4-by- m quaternion array | 3-by-3-by- m rotation matrix array

params.name: Rotation format
params.values: Format for orientations Quaternion (default) | Rotation Matrix

params.name: Initial rotation
params.values: Initial orientation [1 0 0 0]’ (default) | four-element quaternion vector | 3-by-3 rotation matrix

params.name: Final rotation
params.values: Final orientation [0 0 1 0]’ (default) | four-element vector | 3-by-3 rotation matrix

params.name: Time interval
params.values: Start and end times for trajectory [0 10] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Use custom time scaling
params.values: Enable custom time scaling off (default) | on

params.name: Time scaling time
params.values: Time scaling time points 2:0.1:3 (default) | scalar | p -element vector

params.name: Time scaling values
params.values: Time scaling vector and first two derivatives [0:0.1:1; ones(1,11); zeros(1,11)] (default) | three-element vector | 3-by- m matrix

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
